taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: Kubernetes authorization; RBAC permissions are additive and deployment-dependent

controls.boundary: Kubernetes RBAC and delegated workload authority — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Collect roles/bindings, service-account identity, namespace, aggregation and admission/workload creation context. Record exact resource, subresource and verb, not just a role label.
controls.controlled_verification: Evaluate a specified low-privilege subject's effective action using read-only authorization inspection. If workload creation is involved, trace whether that workload can select a more privileged service account under actual admission policy; do not deploy it for proof unless separately within scope.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A wildcard role fragment or ability to create a pod is not automatically cluster-admin. Admission, namespace, identity selection and downstream permissions determine the reachable authority.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Remove the evidenced excess binding/delegation while retaining intended controller/operator operations. Re-evaluate the prohibited action and normal workload behavior.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
